    - For two years I pushed the cart, fetched Thimble's pins and swept the stage. I never said a line. I learned them all anyway. Then this spring there was an audition, and I froze in the wings.

    - A barley-and-geese farm out near Kaldemor. I am the third of five. I came here three years ago on a cider cart and never went back. My mother still writes whenever the carts run, and sends a cake every Walkout Day.
